Depreciation and amortization expenses were also down by $50,504 or 61% from 2023.

ga.text: General and administrative expenses were $706,219 and $714,442 for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with $2,067 and $10,353 for the same periods of 2025. The increase is principally the $620,459 expense for the shares issued to Maxim Group for investment banking services on May 19, 2026, legal and professional fees relating to the litigation and to a proposed registration statement, and condominium rent, maintenance, accounting and transfer agent costs. Stock-based compensation of $183,000 previously reported for the 2025 periods has been reversed because the agreements under which the shares were issued were declared void. Depreciation and amortization increased to $10,024 and $18,232 for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 from $2,000 and $4,000 in 2025 as the condominiums acquired since the third quarter of 2025 and the franchise and development rights were depreciated and amortized.

nonop.text: Interest expense was $6,011 and $11,957 for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with $7,236 and $12,783 (as restated) for the same periods of 2025. Interest expense now consists of interest on the Meridian note ($5,284 and $10,511 in each year) and on the Cloud Builder, Inc. and Advocate CPA, Inc. notes. Interest on the Epazz, Inc. notes assumed in the voided mergers is no longer recognized. The Company recorded no gains or losses on investments because the ZenaTech, Inc. shares received for Ecker Capital, LLC are no longer recognized; the gain of $1,725,833 and loss of $7,296,262 previously reported for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025, and the loss of $5,560,416 in the Company’s draft for the six months ended June 30, 2026, have been reversed.

net.text: The net loss was $715,967 and $732,925 for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with net income of $11,189 and a net loss of $4,644 (as restated) for the corresponding periods of 2025.

intro.text: The Company was organized on December 27, 2010, under the laws of the State of Nevada, as ATVROCKN. On June 20, 2017, the Company changed its corporate name to Ameritek Ventures, Inc (“Ameritek Ventures” or “Ameritek” or the “Company”). Until October 2024 Ameritek was a software company providing various products. On October 1, 2024, Ameritek sold Ecker Capital, LLC, the holding parent company of Interactive Systems, Inc., interlinkOne, Inc. and ESM Software, Inc., to ZenaTech, Inc. On August 14, 2025, Ameritek acquired Galaxy Batteries, Inc. from Epazz, Inc. The Company’s current focus is on solid-state batteries (Galaxy Batteries, Inc.), adaptive manufacturing, robotic manufacturing, aerospace services (AeroPass, Inc.), and luxury corporate housing (Chicago Real Estate Partners, LLC). DittoMask, Inc.

lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

This is due to having a net income of $4,496,799, partially offset by the change in gain on sale of Ecker of $4,439,550, a decrease of accounts receivable of $245,547, accounts payable of $75,303, accrued interest of $42,399 partially offset by an increase in deferred revenue of $327,032, and a decrease of amortization and depreciation of $50,504 in 2024 compared to 2023, all as a result of the sale of Ecker Capital.

da.text: Total operating expenses decreased by$363,928 or 44% since the Company sold the two revenue and expense generating companies on October 1, 2024. Additionally, Ameritek is now using the proprietary server from Epazz, Inc. and not loaning cloud space from third party vendors. Development and support expenses were lower by $222,040 or 43% in 2024. General and administrative expenses were $132,398 for 2024, a decrease by $91,384 or 41% as compared to expenses incurred during 2023. Depreciation and amortization expenses were also down by $50,504 or 61% from 2023.
